about_horus: HORUS OS is a custom Linux-based operating system designed for embedded laptops, AI education, hardware control, and student innovation. It was created by Alaa Saber as a university competition project. Built on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS minimal with XFCE4 desktop, it features full custom branding, 5 purpose-built applications, an AI assistant, and a pre-configured embedded development environment.
creator: Alaa Saber
desktop: XFCE4 with Horus Dark GTK theme
apps: HORUS Control Center — Real-time system monitoring (FastAPI + React)
HORUS AI Assistant — This AI (Python + Ollama/OpenAI + React)
HORUS Demo Mode — Competition kiosk app (React SPA)
HORUS Security Center — Security dashboard (Python + React)

useful_commands.update_system: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y

embedded_reference.gpio_example:
from gpiod import Chip
chip = Chip('gpiochip0')
line = chip.get_line(4)
line.request(consumer='test', type=gpiod.LINE_REQ_DIR_OUT)
line.set_value(1)
embedded_reference.i2c_python:
import smbus2
bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)
data = bus.read_byte(0x48)  # read from address 0x48
embedded_reference.serial_python:
import serial
ser = serial.Serial('/dev/ttyUSB0', 115200)
ser.write(b'Hello Arduino\n')
response = ser.readline()

faq.is_horus_a_distro: HORUS OS is a custom Linux-based operating system, not a Linux distribution in the traditional sense. It is built from Ubuntu 22.04 LTS minimal with comprehensive customizations at every layer — boot, display, desktop, applications, and toolchain.
faq.why_not_scratch: Building a kernel from scratch takes years for a single developer. HORUS OS is correctly positioned as a custom Linux-based OS. The customization at every layer — from boot to applications — creates a genuine independent system identity.
faq.competition_pitch: HORUS OS demonstrates that a student can architect, build, and deploy a complete operating system platform. It solves the real problem of fragmented embedded development environments by providing a unified, branded system purpose-built for embedded intelligence.
faq.what_can_it_do: HORUS OS can run on any x86_64 laptop, control embedded hardware via GPIO/I2C/SPI/serial, run Python and Arduino projects, monitor system health in real-time, provide AI-assisted development help, and present as a professional competition demonstration.
